sloka: यावद्धि केशग्रहणात्सुहृद्भिः ।समेत्य सर्वैः परिपूर्णकामैः ।निगृह्य राजा परिरक्षितव्यो ।भूतैर्यथा भीमबलैर्गृहीअः ॥६-१४-१९॥।।
transliteration: yāvaddhi keśagrahaṇātsuhṛdbhiḥ ।sametya sarvaiḥ paripūrṇakāmaiḥ ।nigṛhya rājā parirakṣitavyo ।bhūtairyathā bhīmabalairgṛhīaḥ ॥6-14-19॥।।

translations.english: "The king will have to be protected by all friends joined together whose wishes have been gratified even by catching him by his hair forcibly just as a man surrounded by a devil of terrific strength is pulled out by his hair."
